purpose: Describe a change into a new state.
keywords: Noun / な-adjective + に; い-adjective ～く + なる.
I want to become a doctor.
formation: Noun / な-adjective + に; い-adjective ～く + なる.
restrictions: なる presents the change rather than someone deliberately causing it.
mistake: Use 暖かくなる, not 暖かいになる.
